info.title: PayLorya AI API
info.summary: Read your books, forecast cash and draft payments from your own systems and agents.
info.description:
PayLorya AI is an AI CFO for businesses, built by CashXChain. This API lets your own systems and agents read what it knows (cash, forecast, payments, documents, budgets, activity) and draft payments, which always wait for a person's approval.

**Auth.** `Authorization: Bearer ply_sk_…`. Create keys in the dashboard (Developers). A key acts for the account that created it.

**Scopes.** `read` covers every GET; `write` covers drafting payments, uploading and deleting documents, and chats.

**Human only.** Approving, rejecting and signing payments, connections, payees, budgets, the agent's rights (workspace), API keys, webhook management and funding answer 403 `human_only` to any key. Operations marked `x-human-only: true` are listed for reference only.

**Rate limit.** 120 requests per minute per key (bursts up to 120), then 429 `rate_limited` with `retry-after`.

**Idempotency.** Send `Idempotency-Key` (max 200 characters) on any write. The same key with the same method, path and body replays the first reply with `idempotent-replayed: true`; a different request gives 422 `idempotency_mismatch`; one still running gives 409 `idempotency_in_progress`. Keys are kept 24 hours, per API key. A reply of 5xx frees the key for a retry.

**Errors.** JSON `{ "error": "…", "code": "…" }`; `code` is present on auth, scope, rate-limit and idempotency errors.

**MCP.** The same key works on the MCP endpoint `https://paylorya.valentin.is/mcp` (Streamable HTTP). Docs: https://paylorya.valentin.is/developers

Test networks only: tADA on Cardano Preprod and the CashXChain sandbox. No real money moves.

post.description: Drafts a payment to a saved payee. A draft made with an API key always waits for a person: its status is `pending_approval` (or `blocked` when it cannot execute as it stands, see `policy.checks`). Nothing is paid until someone approves it in the dashboard. A second open payment for the same payee and amount, or for the same document, is refused with 409.

post.description: Uploads one file (PDF, image, CSV or text; at most 15 MB). It returns at once with `status: processing`; the AI CFO reads it in the background. Poll GET /documents/{id}. Counts against the account's daily AI limit (429 without `code` when reached; 503 when the AI model is not configured).

get.summary: Get a chat with its messages

post.summary: Send a message to the AI CFO
post.description: Sends a message (and up to 10 files) and streams the answer as Server-Sent Events: `user` (your stored message), `text` (`{delta}` chunks), `tool` (`{name, status, summary}`), `done` (`{message}`) or `error` (`{message}`). The AI CFO acts as the agent: payments it drafts follow the account's agent autonomy and limits, set in the dashboard. Counts against the daily AI limit. A replay with the same Idempotency-Key returns the status only, without the stream.

example.text: Which invoices are due this week?

event: text
data: {"delta":"Two invoices are due"}

bearerAuth.description: An account API key, created in the dashboard (Developers).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Any unique string, at most 200 characters. Same key and same request within 24 h: the first reply is returned again, nothing runs twice.

IdempotentReplayed.description: `true` when this reply is a replay of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

BadRequest.description: The request is not valid: the message names the field.

example.error: amountMinor: Too small: expected number to be >0

InvalidKey.description: No valid key: unknown, mistyped or revoked.

example.error: This API key is not valid: unknown, mistyped or revoked.

InsufficientScope.description: The key lacks the scope this call needs.

HumanOnly.description: Only a person signed in to the dashboard can do this.

example.error: This action needs a person signed in to the PayLorya AI dashboard (approving, signing, credentials, payees, budgets, agent rights).

NotFound.description: No such record in this account.

Conflict.description: A conflict: the same Idempotency-Key is still running (`idempotency_in_progress`), or the request clashes with the current state (e.g. an open payment for the same bill).

example.error: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running.

IdempotencyMismatch.description: This Idempotency-Key was used with a different request.

example.error: This Idempotency-Key was used with a different request.

RateLimited.description: More than 120 requests in a minute with this key; or, without `code`, the account's daily AI limit (documents and chat messages).

example.error: Too many requests with this key: try again in 1 s.

retry-after.description: Seconds to wait (key rate limit only).

ServerError.description: Something went wrong on our side. A request with an Idempotency-Key that ends in 5xx can be retried with the same key.

TooLarge.description: The file is larger than 15 MB.

Unavailable.description: The AI model is not configured on this server.

example.error: The AI model is not configured on this server

error.description: What went wrong, in plain English.

code.description: Machine-readable code. Set by the key layer (auth, scopes, rate limit, idempotency); most route errors carry only `error`.

Scope.description: `read`: every GET. `write`: drafting payments, uploading and deleting documents, chats.

prefix.description: Recognisable part of the key, e.g. `ply_sk_AbCd…WxYz`. The key itself is never returned again.

perPaymentUsdMinor.description: Largest payment the agent may execute on its own, USD cents.

monthlyUsdMinor.description: What the agent may execute on its own per calendar month, USD cents.

knownPayeesOnly.description: The agent pays only payees saved in the payee directory on its own.

Workspace.description: The account (workspace) the key belongs to.

autonomy.description: What the AI CFO agent may do on its own. Changed only in the dashboard.

cashxchain.description: CashXChain sandbox sub-account link, once attempted.

funding.description: The one test-tADA grant to the agent wallet, once sent.

amount.description: Decimal string in the asset's major unit.

keyHint.description: Set when the connection carries its own credential; never the credential.

Destination.description: Account details to pay to. Bank fields for fiat rails, `cardanoAddress` for tADA.

iban.description: Spaces are removed and letters upper-cased.

spentUsdMinor.description: Money out in this category this calendar month, USD cents.

amountMinor.description: Signed, in the currency's minor unit: negative is money out.

status.description: `processing` right after upload; the AI CFO reads it in the background.

extracted.description: Raw fields the AI CFO extracted.

dataBase64.description: The file, base64-encoded. At most 15 MB decoded.

PolicyDecision.description: The deterministic policy's verdict. Drafts made with an API key always get `approval` or `blocked`, never `auto`.

PaymentStatus.description: `pending_approval`: waits for a person. `blocked`: cannot execute as it stands (see `policy.checks`). `awaiting_signature`: a tADA payout waiting for the owner's wallet.

destination.description: Only for a payee that is not saved.

amountMinor.description: Minor unit of `currency` (cents; lovelace for ADA; yen for JPY).

rail.description: `cashxchain` for fiat (sandbox), `cardano_preprod` for tADA, `manual` when no rail pays this currency.

requestedBy.description: `user` for drafts made with an API key or in the dashboard; `agent` for the AI CFO's own drafts.

cardano.description: tADA payout details: wallet, verification, transaction and confirmation.

verification.description: The x402 verification report bought on Cardano before the payout.

payoutKey.description: The payout's idempotency key, fixed at the first attempt.

payeeId.description: A saved payee (GET /payees). Payees are added in the dashboard.

amountMinor.description: Minor unit of `currency`: 12000 EUR = 120.00 EUR; ADA in lovelace (1 tADA = 1000000).

currency.description: ADA pays tADA on Cardano Preprod; USD, EUR, GBP, CHF, AED, PLN and SEK go to the CashXChain sandbox; JPY has no rail and is drafted as `blocked`.

documentId.description: Link the payment to an uploaded document.

Forecast.description: Connected balances today, minus open payables on their due dates, plus open receivables. Deterministic; no model involved.
